nodes.description: Owner address state variable in Ownable, set to msg.sender at construction and the root of all access control.
onlyOwner modifier requiring msg.sender == owner, guards privileged setters.
Transfers ownership to newOwner, guarded by onlyOwner.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller used for authorization and refunds.
block.timestamp (now) used for sale timing windows and milestone selection.
Mapping of holder balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom, mint and updateBalance.
BasicToken.transfer moves tokens between balances with SafeMath and zero-address checks.
StandardToken.transferFrom moves tokens using allowance and updates balances/allowed.
MintableToken.mint creates tokens, gated by msg.sender == saleAgent || owner and !mintingFinished.
Boolean flag that permanently stops minting once set.
Authorized minting agent address; controls token supply creation.
SoftcapFeature.refund zeroes the caller balance and sends ETH back to msg.sender.
msg.sender.transfer(value) raw ETH send inside refund; external caller code executes.
Flag enabling refunds when the softcap was not achieved.
SoftcapFeature.withdraw sends devLimit to devWallet and the whole balance to wallet.
wallet.transfer(this.balance) drains entire contract balance to an external address.
Internal fallback: checks timing and min investment, forwards ETH to wallet, then mints.
wallet.transfer(msg.value) external ETH send executed before invested state is updated.
GeseToken.processCallback invokes tokenFallback on registered recipient contracts after transfers.
targetCallback.tokenFallback(from, value) arbitrary external call to a recipient contract.
Mapping of addresses allowed to receive tokenFallback callbacks.
CommonSale.mintTokens mints tokens to this contract then transfers them to the beneficiary.
token.mint(this, tokens) external call that increases supply on an externally set token.
ReferersRewardFeature.fallback calls super.fallback and mints referer bonus tokens.
PreITO override of mintTokensByETH that additionally records the investor balance.
SoftcapFeature.updateBalance tracks per-address contributions and flips softcapAchieved.
Total ETH invested; compared against hardcap and softcap.
Array of Milestone structs (period, bonus) driving staged pricing.
StagedCrowdsale.addMilestone pushes a milestone and increases totalPeriod.
AssembledCommonSale.calculateTokens computes token amount using current milestone bonus.
totalPeriod.add(period) accumulator modified by every milestone operation.
InputAddressFeature.bytesToAddress converts raw calldata bytes into an address.
Unchecked mul = mul*256 loop in bytesToAddress, overflow unprotected by SafeMath.
MintableToken.setSaleAgent changes the minting agent, gated on msg.sender == saleAgent || owner.
PreITO.finish either finishes minting (refund path) or withdraws and hands off to nextSaleAgent.
PreITO.fallback performs the timing check, mints tokens and pays the referer bonus.
SoftcapFeature.updateRefundState enables refundOn when the softcap was missed.
Maximum ETH the sale will accept; checked by isUnderHardcap.
Minimum ETH needed for the sale to be considered successful.
Sum of all milestone periods, used to compute the sale end date.
token.transfer(to, tokens) external call pushing freshly minted tokens to a user address.
MintableToken.finishMinting permanently disables minting, gated on msg.sender == saleAgent || owner.
StagedCrowdsale.currentMilestone selects the active milestone using block.timestamp.
CommonSale.setHardcap updates the hardcap under onlyOwner.
CommonSale.setToken points the sale at a new MintableToken under onlyOwner.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
_to parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
_value parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
_amount parameter of mint.
newSaleAgnet parameter of setSaleAgent.
period parameter of addMilestone.
bonus parameter of addMilestone.
newHardcap parameter of setHardcap.
referer local derived from getInputAddress in the sale fallbacks.
tokens local holding the minted amount used for referer bonus.
value local holding the refundable balance in refund.
milestoneIndex local returned by currentMilestone in calculateTokens.

edges.reason: Owner is assigned directly from msg.sender in the Ownable constructor, making the caller the privileged account.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner to gate privileged functions.
transferOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
mint authorizes supply creation using msg.sender == saleAgent || owner.
setSaleAgent authorizes minting-rights transfer using msg.sender.
finishMinting authorizes mint shutdown using msg.sender.
refund reads balances[msg.sender] and sends ETH to the untrusted caller.
withdraw gates fund extraction on msg.sender == owner || devWallet.
mintTokens mints to the address derived from the caller in the sale fallback path.
Raw ETH is delivered to msg.sender.transfer, executing arbitrary caller code.
CommonSale.fallback gates the purchase on now >= start && now < endSaleDate().
PreITO.fallback gates the purchase window using block.timestamp.
currentMilestone compares now against cumulative milestone periods.
PreITO.finish consults updateRefundState to decide between refund and handoff.
PreITO.finish calls withdraw on the successful-softcap path.
updateRefundState flips refundOn when the softcap was never reached.
withdraw performs the wallet.transfer(this.balance) drain.
refund zeroes the balance and then performs the ETH transfer to msg.sender.
A contract msg.sender can re-enter refund during the ETH transfer callback.
The value local is the ETH amount sent to msg.sender in refund.
fallback forwards msg.value to wallet before updating invested state.
wallet.transfer executes external code that can re-enter fallback and bypass hardcap checks.
fallback calls mintTokensByETH after the ETH transfer.
ReferersRewardFeature.fallback delegates to super.fallback.
PreITO.fallback calls mintTokensByETH for the investor.
PreITO.mintTokensByETH records the contribution through updateBalance.
updateBalance reads invested to detect softcap achievement.
updateBalance accumulates the contribution into balances[to].
updateBalance compares invested against softcap.
mintTokens invokes token.mint(this, tokens).
mintTokens invokes token.transfer(to, tokens).
token.mint increases the supply backing the minted balances.
token.transfer moves balances to the beneficiary.
processCallback invokes the external tokenFallback on a registered recipient.
The arbitrary callback can re-enter the token transfer flow before completion.
processCallback only executes the callback when registeredCallbacks[to] is true.
mint checks the mintingFinished flag before creating supply.
finishMinting sets mintingFinished to true.
mint credits balances[_to] with the minted amount.
transfer debits and credits the balances mapping.
transferFrom debits and credits the balances mapping.
addMilestone accumulates totalPeriod through totalPeriod.add(period).
The period parameter feeds the totalPeriod accumulator.
The bonus parameter is pushed into the milestones array.
The period parameter is pushed into the milestones array.
totalPeriod state is mutated by the milestone arithmetic.
calculateTokens reads the milestone bonus from the milestones array.
calculateTokens calls currentMilestone to pick the active milestone.
milestoneIndex indexes into the milestones array.
currentMilestone iterates the milestones array to find the active period.
bytesToAddress uses an unchecked mul accumulator circumventing SafeMath.
The referer local is produced by decoding raw calldata via bytesToAddress.
The tokens local is passed to mintTokens for the referer bonus.
setSaleAgent writes the new minting agent into saleAgent.
The newSaleAgnet parameter is stored into saleAgent.
The isUnderHardcap modifier compares invested against hardcap.
setHardcap rewrites the hardcap value under onlyOwner.
The newHardcap parameter flows into setHardcap.
setToken is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
The newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged owner.
The _to parameter is the token transfer destination.
The _value parameter is the transferred token amount.
The _amount parameter is the minted token amount.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter exists only as the argument of transferOwnership and is meaningless without that core function.
The _to parameter is only used as the destination of BasicToken.transfer.
The _value parameter is only used as the amount moved by BasicToken.transfer.
The _amount parameter is only consumed by the mint function.
The newSaleAgnet parameter is directly assigned to saleAgent inside setSaleAgent.
The period parameter is pushed into milestones and added to totalPeriod within addMilestone.
The bonus parameter is stored into the Milestone struct inside addMilestone.
The newHardcap parameter is directly written to the hardcap state variable by setHardcap.
The referer local is computed and validated only inside the referer reward fallback.
The tokens local holds the base mint amount and is only consumed within the referer fallback.
The value local is the amount transferred out by the refund function.
The milestoneIndex local is derived inside calculateTokens to index the milestones array.
